prompt_en: Create a cinematic photographic portrait of an adult planetarium projectionist aligning a brass star projector after closing time. Preserve the supplied portrait reference's facial appearance, long dark wavy hair, and softly parted lips. She stands behind a waist-high control console, her right hand turning a large reachable focus knob while her left palm rests on the console edge; her shoulders remain level above planted feet. Her gaze follows a tiny sharp constellation projected onto a frosted calibration plate beside the mechanism. Show her from the hips upward in a three-quarter frontal view, with both forearms connected visibly to their hands and the brass projector offset beside her. Cyan light arriving from camera left and amber light arriving from camera right meet across the same face and black work blouse, retaining separate colored sides and a readable central transition. A narrow magenta light traces the outer hair and far shoulder from behind. An emerald light wash spreads broadly over the curved planetarium wall behind her, visibly separate from the colors on her body. The calibration stars remain small white points against the illuminated wall. Fine metal gears, a cream paper star chart, and a coiled instrument cable create a lived-in technical setting. Prioritize readable facial likeness and physically distinct colored illumination, with detailed skin and brass surfaces, restrained atmospheric haze, and cinematic photographic depth. Across her nose and blouse folds, differently colored light contributions arrive from distinct visible directions; their separate receiving footprints follow surface orientation and occlusion. Along the rear hair edge, colored illumination follows a narrow source-facing contour of the subject; the contour light remains spatially distinct from the interior key-lit surfaces. Use a 50mm lens at eye level so the face and knob share readable focus. Place the illuminated calibration plate above the projector to form a triangular path from her eyes through the stars down to her hand.
negative_en: cartoon style, broken facial features, warped walls, fake-looking background, excessive HDR, plastic-looking skin, low resolution, 3D render look, impossible perspective, body distortion
